objective:
Independent review rejected two behaviors: a row with a missing amount column value (customer,amount followed by A without comma) raises AttributeError instead of a clear stderr error and exit 2; quoted customer names lose intentional leading/trailing spaces. Preserve the exact nonempty customer field while rejecting whitespace-only names. Repair these minimally and add discoverable regression tests. Keep all previously passing behavior.
Original requirements: Fix this invoice CSV utility for decimal money. Keep the CLI python invoice.py PATH and summarize(stream). Parse amounts with Decimal, reject non-finite/invalid amounts with a clear stderr message and exit 2 (no traceback). Round each row to cents using ROUND_HALF_UP before summing; support negative refunds. Return JSON customer-to-amount strings with exactly two decimal digits, including zero. Keep quoted customer names intact. A header-only CSV returns {}. Reject missing customer/amount columns, empty customer names and empty amounts. Add regression tests and update the README. Use Python standard library only. Put at least three discoverable regression tests under tests/ (test_* methods). Remove scratch files; deliver only Python source/tests and Markdown documentation.
